ValidationRule.description: Requires Singpass identity fields during active processing and Singpass authentication from Consent Request onward.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Singpass", OR( ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Upload"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Consent Request"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Active Consent"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Processing"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Report Request"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Report Fulfilment"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Departure") ), OR( ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLANK(Full_Name__c), ISBLANK(Email), ISBLANK(TEXT(ID_Type__c)), ISBLANK(ID_Number__c), ISBLANK(Date_of_Birth__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Employment_Status__c)), AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Upload")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Authentication_Type__c, "Singpass")) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete the required Singpass identity and authentication fields before continuing this active processing stage.
